name: Breeze Charm
desc: A tiny sail that hums when the wind is friendly.

name: Rope Charm
desc: A neat coil of rope that never tangles.

name: Vane Charm
desc: It always points the way the wind is going.

name: Crate Charm
desc: A little crate with a very big smile.

name: Foghorn Charm
desc: It toots a happy note when the sea is calm.

name: Bell Charm
desc: The Dock Bell sings through this charm.

name: Sea Shell
desc: A pearly shell from Lantern Rock.

name: Rope Coil
desc: A coil of good rope from the Rope Yard.

name: Harbor Pilot Badge
desc: Earned by waking all six Route Temples at Sky Dock.

name: Sailor Knot Pin
desc: A pin for anyone who helps with the ropes.
